doc.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022

chapter: Family and life on the road
title: Downtime on the road
summary: Pre-television nights listening to radio and reading; routines came from that time.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Yeah. And for a person who spent — when we’d get finished when we first started traveling there was no TV and — there was a TV but hotels didn’t have them, only just a © Fillius Jazz Archive -25-

few private homes. And so there was the radio. And the only thing on late at night was WWBA Wheeling, West Virginia which was all country you know. So you’d listen to the radio and you’d read a book or read the paper.
Yeah, there’s a lot of hours to pass.
Maybe some of your routines came out of that downtime.
